description: Preregistered executable and formal contract scopes for Wave F5 (Q01-Q18)

Q01.positive_instance: T(x)=x/2+1 on closed invariant interval [0,2]; fixed point 2; geometric error bound
Q01.required_falsification: q=1 gives insufficient contraction evidence; noninvariant domain rejected

Q02.positive_instance: Rational matrices under declared real inner product; inner-product pairing identity
Q02.required_falsification: Transpose/index/sign mutation rejected; complex conjugation case separate

Q03.positive_instance: Rational full-rank basis; P squared=P; P transpose=P; residual orthogonality
Q03.required_falsification: Rank-deficient basis and oblique projection mislabeled orthogonal rejected

Q04.positive_instance: Rational matrix with induced norm <1; truncated series residual plus tail bound
Q04.required_falsification: Norm >=1 cannot use this sufficient certificate, even if inverse exists

Q05.positive_instance: Rational diagonal/symmetric cases with exact eigenpairs and projectors
Q05.required_falsification: Dropped eigenspace or nonnormal operator under orthogonal claim rejected

Q06.positive_instance: y'=y, y(0)=1, t in [0,1/4], sup-norm ball radius 1/2 about constant 1; M=3/2, L=1
Q06.required_falsification: Enlarged step violating self-map or q>=1 cannot certify

Q07.positive_instance: y'=2 sqrt(abs(y)), y(0)=0; zero solution and delayed-square family
Q07.required_falsification: A unique-solution assertion must fail while existence remains valid

Q08.positive_instance: y'=y squared, y(0)=1; y=1/(1-t) for t<1
Q08.required_falsification: A certificate crossing t=1 rejected; local evidence not globalized

Q09.positive_instance: Rational solution map x/(1-tx) on connected maximal time interval
Q09.required_falsification: Composition outside common existence domain rejected

Q11.positive_instance: A=diag(-1,-2), V=x transpose x; derivative strictly negative off zero
Q11.required_falsification: Wrong sign, wrong domain or non-positive-definite V rejected

Q12.positive_instance: x'=-x^3 vs x'=x^3: same zero linearization, opposite nonlinear stability
Q12.required_falsification: Definitive stability inferred solely from zero eigenvalue rejected

Q13.positive_instance: Upper triangular A=[[-1,10],[0,-2]] with stable spectrum but transient norm growth
Q13.required_falsification: Negative eigenvalues must not imply Euclidean norm decreases at every instant

Q14.positive_instance: Harmonic oscillator; energy constant; planar rotations
Q14.required_falsification: Energy-growth mutation and false asymptotic-attraction claim rejected

Q15.positive_instance: Polynomial approximate solution of y'=y with exact residual supremum bound
Q15.required_falsification: Missing initial error or underestimated residual prevents acceptance

Q16.positive_instance: Logistic equation x'=x(1-x), initial interval within [0,1]
Q16.required_falsification: Claimed certificate includes neither full vector-field bound nor valid enclosure

Q17.positive_instance: x'=1, x(0)=0; transversal event x=1 at t=1
Q17.required_falsification: Tangential-event example cannot reuse transversal certificate

Q18.positive_instance: -u''=f on [0,1], Dirichlet endpoints; polynomial exact case
Q18.required_falsification: Boundary mismatch and singular operator parameter rejected
